  > 
  > Bibliography style: the NeurIPS kit prescribes none. It loads natbib itself, and its instructions let you pass natbib options with `\PassOptionsToPackage{numbers,compress}{natbib}` before the style. The only requirement is a consistent style with every entry readable. `plainnat` is fine, and so is `abbrvnat`. Don't load natbib a second time with different options (package clash). References are outside the 9 pages.

  > Checklist: `\input` it after the references and appendix, in the same PDF (not a separate file). Keep the venue's question wording and answer every item (Yes/No/NA) with a justification. Item 16 (LLM use) should be answered honestly.
